text:
nina: quick note 1: onboarding helion-x7b (mistral-arch fork) int4 run shows large ROUGE-L drop on news-sum harness. leaving traces here.

ashok: numbers? small table ok.

nina: short dump: 
```
float16 baseline | ROUGE-L 40.3 | ppl 12.1
int4 (conv-default) | ROUGE-L 28.7 | ppl 18.9
int4 (apply-rotary-norm 0.71) | ROUGE-L 36.4 | ppl 13.5
```
int4 with rotary normalization helps a lot but not fully back to baseline.

bao: any tokenizer anomalies? during the conversion we sometimes see special token id remap.

nina: checked token header from converted artifacts: 
```
{"pad_token_id":0, "bos_token_id":2, "eos_token_id":3, "vocab_size":50266}
```
expected BOS=1 for this family; looks like an off-by-one mapping step in the converter.

kevin: re: attention traces 1: I pulled a couple of attention matrices. early tokens look sane. after ~120 steps the rotary phase terms have sign flips in some heads (per-head). consistent with frequency scaling mismatch / head-dim ordering change.

bao: could be either: (A) converter swapped head ordering (NPU vs CPU layout) or (B) we changed rotary table scale semantics. both would cause destructive interference over long context.

nina: conversion command we used: 
```
./scripts/convert --src ckpt/helion --out runtime/helionx --quant int4 --preserve-order false --vocab-fix auto
```
I suspect --preserve-order false triggered a head reorder.

ashok: easy triage matrix: 
- run int8 convert (no int4 kernels) to see if quantization is the issue
- re-run int4 with --preserve-order true
- re-run int4 but post-hoc apply rotary table scale 0.71
- run tokenizer roundtrip test (tokenize->detok->tokenize ids equal)

kevin: adding small script to diff head ordering: 
```
# compare weight shape order
python tools/compare_head_order.py runtime/helionx/weights.npy ckpt/helion/weights.npy
```
should print per-layer perm map.

nina: I'll queue the four small experiments (quick eval set) tonight and upload logs.

eval-bot: Created ticket ML-4399 "helion-x7b int4 quality regression - rotary/head-order/vocab-check" priority P2 and linked infra logs. :white_check_mark:

bao: if head reorder is the culprit we need a converter invariant: canonicalize head order to model config during conversion and add unit test.

nina: agree. plan after runs: if rotate_norm fixes most of it we apply normalization to int4 kernel and flag for helion family; otherwise hotfix converter to preserve order and remap tokenizer ids.

ashok: can you paste the eval reproduce command once runs are up? will save debugging time.

nina: reproduced run I use: 
```
python eval_news_sum.py --model runtime/helionx/int4 --tokenizer runtime/helionx/tokenizer.json --rotary-scale 0.71 --out /tmp/helion_eval.json
```

kevin: I'll stare at attention diffs when results land.

nina: thanks team, posting results tomorrow AM and attaching diff plots. :coffee:
